name: angle-field
title: Angle field
description: A rotation in degrees as a dial and a number box: drag the handle, type a value or step with the arrow keys, with an optional compass reading.
docs: 0 is straight up and the angle grows clockwise, as in CSS, so the value drops into a gradient, a shadow direction or a rotate(). Drag the dial (Shift snaps to snap, 15 degrees by default), press the arrow keys (Shift jumps along the grid, Home goes to 0), or type in the box. With wrap on, the default, past 359 comes 0; with wrap off the angle stops at min and max. The dial is a slider that reads '90 degrees', or with compass '90 degrees, east', and size is sm, default or lg.
